authority.custody_note: The incremental packet remains retrievable at packet_commit:packet_path_at_commit and is bound by packet_blob_sha256. It is intentionally absent from the final pull-request tree because CI binds the complete merge-base-to-head event to one consolidated Session Entry packet; this note does not upgrade the historical local preflight into a committed closeout receipt.

bootstrap_constraint.counterexample: A packet bound to a new track fails preflight because that track is absent at the clean base. A packet bound to a removed track can preflight but fails closeout because that track is absent from the resulting owner file.
bootstrap_constraint.handling: The atomic transition was committed after direct whole-state tests, then the resulting state was bound and re-tested by this packet. This receipt does not relabel the earlier commit as preflight-admitted.

exclusions: Ratification proves only the checked local governance state and declared active portfolio.
It does not prove runtime liveness, deployment, remote state, participant outcomes, research quality, or production readiness.
It does not authorize deployment, spending, credentials, outreach, or mutation of remote systems.
